name: Directive 17
tagline: The Future Should Make Life Better.
subline: We build companies that improve the human experience.

home_pillars.title: Happiness
home_pillars.body: Smiles, laughter, celebration, memories, and a life well lived.

home_pillars.title: Human Potential
home_pillars.body: Helping people become more capable than ever before.

paragraphs: Every day, billions of people wake up hoping for healthier lives, stronger relationships, more meaningful work, more joyful experiences, and a better future for their families.
We believe business can help create that future — not by chasing trends, but by building enduring companies that genuinely improve people's lives.
why_page.belief_intro: Progress should improve the human experience.
beliefs: Technology should make life more human.

philosophy_page.opening: When the history of this century is written...
philosophy_page.q1: Will technology have made us more human?
philosophy_page.answer: Directive 17 exists because we believe the answer should be both.
philosophy_page.pillars_intro: The human outcomes we are building toward.

human_test.label: The Human Test
human_test.intro: Every company begins with one question.
human_test.question: How will this make someone's life better?
human_test.after: Only then do we ask whether it can become a great business.

way.label: The Directive 17 Way
pairs: We don't believe technology is the destination.
way.closing: Smile more. Laugh more. Love more. Learn more. Live better. Help others. Leave the world better than you found it.

future_page.old_q: The old question was: what future is coming?
future_page.body: These forces will reshape the next century. Directive 17 exists to help ensure that progress makes everyday life healthier, kinder, happier, more connected, more trusting, and more human.

build_page.headline: Build with us.
build_page.body: The future is built by people who believe it can be better.
